doc.brief: The base class for event controllers.
doc.md:
The base class for event controllers.

These are ancillary objects associated to widgets, which react
to `GdkEvents`, and possibly trigger actions as a consequence.

Event controllers are added to a widget with
[`Widget.add_controller()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:add_controller). It is rarely necessary to
explicitly remove a controller with [`Widget.remove_controller()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:remove_controller).

See the chapter on [input handling](input-handling.html) for
an overview of the basic concepts, such as the capture and bubble
phases of event propagation.

get_current_event.brief: Returns the event that is currently being handled by the controller.
get_current_event.md:
Returns the event that is currently being handled by the controller.

At other times, `NULL` is returned.

get_current_event_device.brief: Returns the device of the event that is currently being handled by the controller.
get_current_event_device.md:
Returns the device of the event that is currently being
handled by the controller.

At other times, `NULL` is returned.

get_current_event_state.brief: Returns the modifier state of the event that is currently being handled by the controller.
get_current_event_state.md:
Returns the modifier state of the event that is currently being
handled by the controller.

At other times, 0 is returned.

get_current_event_time.brief: Returns the timestamp of the event that is currently being handled by the controller.
get_current_event_time.md:
Returns the timestamp of the event that is currently being
handled by the controller.

At other times, 0 is returned.

get_propagation_limit.brief: Gets the propagation limit of the event controller.
get_propagation_limit.md: Gets the propagation limit of the event controller.

get_propagation_phase.brief: Gets the propagation phase at which `controller` handles events.
get_propagation_phase.md: Gets the propagation phase at which `controller` handles events.

get_widget.brief: Returns the `GtkWidget` this controller relates to.
get_widget.md: Returns the `GtkWidget` this controller relates to.

reset.brief: Resets the `controller` to a clean state.
reset.md: Resets the `controller` to a clean state.

set_name.brief: Sets a name on the controller that can be used for debugging.
set_name.md: Sets a name on the controller that can be used for debugging.

set_propagation_limit.brief: Sets the event propagation limit on the event controller.
set_propagation_limit.md:
Sets the event propagation limit on the event controller.

If the limit is set to %GTK_LIMIT_SAME_NATIVE, the controller
won't handle events that are targeted at widgets on a different
surface, such as popovers.

set_propagation_phase.brief: Sets the propagation phase at which a controller handles events.
set_propagation_phase.md:
Sets the propagation phase at which a controller handles events.

If `phase` is %GTK_PHASE_NONE, no automatic event handling will be
performed, but other additional gesture maintenance will.

set_static_name.brief: Sets a name on the controller that can be used for debugging.
set_static_name.md: Sets a name on the controller that can be used for debugging.

name.brief: The name for this controller, typically used for debugging purposes.
name.md: The name for this controller, typically used for debugging purposes.

propagation-limit.brief: The limit for which events this controller will handle.
propagation-limit.md: The limit for which events this controller will handle.

propagation-phase.brief: The propagation phase at which this controller will handle events.
propagation-phase.md: The propagation phase at which this controller will handle events.

widget.brief: The widget receiving the `GdkEvents` that the controller will handle.
widget.md: The widget receiving the `GdkEvents` that the controller will handle.
